title: A PR merges alone and may combine several reviewed lanes when that saves CI
ruling: Owner 15:33 CST Nov 13, to the retrospective: "yup A is good" (page item 767 a), built on his 15:31 words that merges, batches and individual lanes were never exclusive, an either or. A PR merges alone; it may combine several reviewed lanes as one PR when that saves CI. For the drain: one combined PR per step group of keep rows that read done, each merging alone on its own green run. Only the wording of CLAUDE.md rule git-integration-branch-merge changes ("Each lane PR merges alone" becomes "A PR merges alone; it may combine several reviewed lanes"), not the tool. backlog-drain-plan's "Runner 10 batches" is rewritten in place to this.
source: Owner chat with the retrospective 15:33 CST Nov 13, relayed 15:34 CST; filed by triage.
